text: Three cable flies. Same move, but the cable angle decides which part of your chest works.
High to low. The cable pulls your arms up, so your chest pulls down and in. At the peak, lower chest takes about sixty percent.
Mid height. A pure hug. Tension peaks early, and mid chest does over half the work.
Low to high. Now you drive up and in. Upper chest takes over, with the front delts helping.
Pick the angle for the chest you want. Save this for chest day.
